column1: # generated_tables.tsv -- EVERY GENERATED TABLE A LANDING REGENERATES (DESIGN-PLAN box-scheduler steps 18 and 19, the cao 2026-11-04, CTO-496; read by s4e_land.sh).
# A generated file is regenerated from its committed source, never edited and never merged by hand. One row per generated file; rows sharing a name are one generator.
# Commands run from the root that holds SCRIP, harness, corpus and .github. check: rc 0 current, rc 1 stale, rc 2 cannot measure. write: rewrites every output of the name.
# phase source: a function of committed files, regenerated before the build. phase binary: derived from the built libscrip_rt.so, re-derived after the build
# (its write rewrites its output, then every source row is regenerated again and SCRIP rebuilt). phase built: a function of committed files whose check
# refuses without a built binary (the parser sync gate's stale-binary preflight), so it is checked after the build like a binary table. A table cut from an oracle or an upstream package
# (util_gen_pl_meta_specs.py --cut, the Raku case and core-name tables, the Unicode and Rakudo method tables, the JCON sources) is re-cut on purpose and is not here.
